newsitem.title: USA: RTRS-Moody's says Australia budget has no impact.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moody's says Australia budget has no impact.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said that the Australian government's 1997/98 budget would have no impact on the nation's AA2 sovereign debt rating.

"We would characterise the overall situation for Australia from a credit rating perspective as stable and we don't see the budget having an impact on the outlook at this stage," Moody's regional debt analyst Yves Lamar told Reuters.
Lamar said Moody's was not going to make a detailed comment about the specifics of the budget for the July/June year.

"But if one looks at the deficit reduction target for the underlying trend contained in this year's budget and compares those with what was announced in the first budget there are some delays or slippage if you will in the deficit reduction targets," he said.
